name: Trenfher

attributes.attribute: a title of the god Ogmios
signifies the great strength of Ogmios

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Trenfher is a title of the god Ogmios in the Welsh tradition. The title marks his great strength. It is applied to the god because he is called Trenfher for his power. The fuller record of this god is under the heading Ogmios.
